sec: Malaria: diagnosis and treatment of uncomplicated and complicated disease

items.q: Microscopy — match — 1) Thick smear 2) Thin smear … A) Not sensitive B) Gold standard with Giemsa staining and light microscopy
items.exp: 'Thick smear : Gold standard, Giemsa staining and light microscopy'; 'Thin smear : Not sensitive'. (Book p1060)

items.q: Which stain is printed for the QBC test?
How many QBC tests and at what spacing does the page require before declaring no malaria?
items.exp: '· 3 QBC tests 12 hours apart → Negative → No malaria'. (Book p1060)

items.q: What is printed about the rapid diagnostic test based on HRP2?

Uncomplicated malaria therapy — match — 1) First line 2) Alternatives … A) Artemether 80 mg plus lumefantrine 480 mg, four tablets twice daily for 3 days B) Atovaquone plus proguanil, clindamycin plus mefloquine, doxycycline plus quinine, artesunate plus amodiaquine, artesunate plus mefloquine
items.exp: 'Uncomplicated malaria : (oral therapy) · Artemether 80mg + Lumefantrine 480mg (First line) — 4 tablets BD × 3 days', then the listed alternatives. (Book p1060)

items.q: How is the artemether-lumefantrine course printed?
opts: 2 tablets three times daily for 7 days

items.q: Fill up (Complicated malaria): 'Day 1 : 3 doses IV artesunate (120 mg / ______ mg per kg) at 0, 12 and 24 hours.'
items.exp: 'Day 1 : 3 doses I/V Artesunate (120mg / 2.4mg per kg) at 0, 12 and 24 hours'. (Book p1060)

items.q: What artesunate dose is printed for days 2 and 3?
items.exp: 'Day 2 : 2.4 mg/kg single dose. Day 3 : 2.4 mg/kg single dose'. (Book p1060)

items.q: Judge the treatment block: I Uncomplicated malaria is treated with oral therapy, artemether-lumefantrine first line. II Complicated malaria is treated with intravenous artesunate for three days.
items.exp: 'Uncomplicated malaria : (oral therapy)' with artemether-lumefantrine first line, and 'Complicated : (I/V therapy)' with day 1-3 artesunate. (Book p1060)

items.q: A patient reports fever on day 3 of illness and microscopy is planned. Which smear and stain does the page call the gold standard?
opts: Thick smear with Giemsa staining and light microscopy
items.exp: 'microscopy (Day 3) : Thick smear : Gold standard, Giemsa staining and light microscopy'; the thin smear is 'Not sensitive'. (Book p1060)

items.q: Which combination is printed as atovaquone-based therapy?
Which is NOT printed among the oral options for uncomplicated malaria?
items.exp: Printed oral options: artemether-lumefantrine, atovaquone-proguanil, clindamycin-mefloquine, doxycycline-quinine, artesunate-amodiaquine and artesunate-mefloquine. (Book p1060)
